task:
System Map: expose the factual planet class and render recognisable body families instead of grey generic planets (map review finding M12). Backend (apps/api) + apps/web. No SQL migration, no workflow, no production operation.

VERIFIED ON MAIN (a8d1b794):
- `GET /api/v1/systems/{id64}/bodies` (`apps/api/src/routers/v3.py`, `BodyV1`) returns `body_type` from `v3_vocab.body_type.public_code`, which is only `star` | `planet` | `barycentre` | `belt_cluster`. No planet class is exposed. The canonical `{schema}.bodies` table has no subtype column.
- The planet class DOES exist in the published derived data: `v3_derived.body_mechanics.body_class` (migration 003) holds the Spansh `subType` per `(derived_generation_id, system_id64, body_pk)` — e.g. "Earth-like world", "Water world", "Ammonia world", "High metal content world", "Metal-rich body", "Rocky body", "Rocky Ice world", "Icy body", "Class I gas giant" … "Class V gas giant", "Gas giant with water-based life", "Gas giant with ammonia-based life", "Helium-rich gas giant", "Helium gas giant", "Water giant" (see `apps/api/src/domain/ratings_v4.py` `_body_key` / `_native_economies` for the keys already recognised). The published derived generation is resolved the way `local_search.resolve_published_generation` / `_current_derived_generation` do it.
- In the web app, `apps/web/src/lib/api/client.ts` `SystemDetailBody` carries no class; `apps/web/src/lib/spatial/system-scene.ts` `buildSystemScene` derives a subtype only for stars, so `babylon/adapter.ts` `systemBodyColour`'s branches for water world / gas giant / icy etc. are unreachable and every planet renders as the same grey sphere labelled "Planet" (live Sol: Earth, Jupiter, the Moon all "Planet", all grey).

WHAT TO DO:
1. API: add an optional `body_class: str | None` to `BodyV1`, read with a LEFT JOIN LATERAL (or a second bounded query keyed by `body_pk`) from `v3_derived.body_mechanics` for the currently published derived generation (fail soft: when no derived generation is published or the row is absent, `body_class` is null; never 503 the bodies route for this). Also add `body_class_source: Literal["ratings-v4-derived"] | None` so the UI can state where the fact came from. Parameterised SQL only; keep the route's existing read-only pool, limits and ordering. Update `apps/web/src/lib/api/generated` via the repository's OpenAPI regeneration path (check `apps/web/package.json` scripts and `tests/` OpenAPI snapshot/contract tests; regenerate and update the checked-in contract rather than hand-editing).
2. Web view model: `SystemDetailBody` gains `bodyClass: string | null` (raw fact, display verbatim) and the scene builder derives a presentation-only `bodyFamily` from it with ONE pure function in `system-scene.ts`: families earth-like, water-world, ammonia-world, high-metal-content, metal-rich, rocky, rocky-ice, icy, gas-giant-class-i..v (one family 'gas-giant' with a variant for class), gas-giant-life, helium-gas-giant, water-giant, unknown. Unknown is used only for null/unrecognised classes. Stars are unchanged (they already use the shared stellar classifier).
3. Renderer: give each family a distinct, restrained material (colour + optional subtle emissive/roughness; no textures required): earth-like blue/green, water world deep blue, ammonia world muted brown-orange, HMC grey-brown, metal-rich dark warm grey, rocky tan, rocky-ice pale grey-blue, icy white-blue, gas giants banded tones per class (I pale, II cream, III blue-grey, IV red-brown, V deep red), life-bearing giants with a green/violet tint, helium giants pale, water giants blue-white; unknown stays the current neutral grey with a visibly different (dashed/dim) treatment so "unknown" cannot be mistaken for a class. Route the family through `systemBodyColour` (replace its name-sniffing). Rings and landable badges unchanged.
4. Inspect / System Map UI: wherever a body is listed as "Planet" (Inspect bodies tab, System Map hover/selection card, body pane), show the raw `bodyClass` when present (e.g. "Earth-like world") and keep "Planet" only when it is null; add a compact legend of the families actually present in the current system (visible on the System Map), with an explicit "Unknown class" entry when any body lacks a class.
5. Do not invent classes from names, radius or mass; do not change layout/hierarchy (that is M13, separate); do not touch the frozen Ratings V4 scoring.

TESTS:
- API: PostgreSQL test (pattern of `tests/test_local_autocomplete_postgres.py` / fixture generation in `tests/ratings_v4_pg_fixture.py`) proving `body_class` is populated from the published derived generation and null when absent; unit test for the OpenAPI contract change.
- Web: pure-function table test for the family mapping over every Spansh subType string listed above plus unknown/null; `system-scene` test that the Sol-like fixture yields distinct families for an Earth-like, a gas giant and an icy body; adapter NullEngine test that two bodies of different families get different material colours and an unknown body gets the unknown treatment; component test for the raw class label and the legend. Existing tests must keep passing; regenerate any OpenAPI snapshot and say so in CHANGES.md.

VALIDATION: full Python unit suite for apps/api changes (the repo's pytest invocation; DB tests need the local PostgreSQL fixture), and in apps/web `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`. CHANGES.md: one dated 2026-11-02 entry; note the visible change needs Product E2E/visual validation before production promotion and is not deployed.
